unsupported.why: nothing maps onto it. The only action that continues an interrupted build is also the full rebuild and the repair — on a damaged index it deletes the unreadable file first — so mapping resume onto it would smuggle a destructive rebuild into the one verb the ruling says never rebuilds, invisibly, because on a healthy checkpointed index it really does just resume
